info.name: NGINX njs Scripting Connections Stream Keyvals API
NGINX Return Key-Value Pairs from All Stream Keyval Zones

params.name: fields
params.description: If the “<literal>fields</literal>” value is empty, then only stream keyval zone names will be output.

items.docs: Returns key-value pairs for each stream keyval shared memory [zone](https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_keyval_module.html#keyval_zone).

info.name: NGINX Return Key-Value Pairs from a Stream Keyval Zone

params.name: streamKeyvalZoneName
params.description: The name of a stream keyval shared memory zone.

params.name: key
params.description: Get a particular key-value pair from the stream keyval zone.

items.docs: Returns key-value pairs stored in a particular stream keyval shared memory [zone](https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_keyval_module.html#keyval_zone).

info.name: NGINX Add a Key-Value Pair to the Stream Keyval Zone

params.name: streamKeyvalZoneName
params.description: The name of a stream keyval shared memory zone.

items.docs: Adds a new key-value pair to the stream keyval shared memory [zone](https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_keyval_module.html#keyval_zone). Several key-value pairs can be entered if the stream keyval shared memory zone is empty.

info.name: NGINX Modify a Key-Value or Delete a Key

params.name: streamKeyvalZoneName
params.description: The name of a stream keyval shared memory zone.

items.docs: Changes the value of the selected key in the key-value pair, deletes a key by setting the key value to null, changes expiration time of a key-value pair. If synchronization of keyval zones in a cluster is enabled, deletes a key only on a target cluster node. Expiration time is specified in milliseconds with the *expire* parameter which overrides the [*timeout*](https://nginx.org/en/docs/s

info.name: NGINX Empty the Stream Keyval Zone

params.name: streamKeyvalZoneName
params.description: The name of a stream keyval shared memory zone.

items.docs: Deletes all key-value pairs from the stream keyval shared memory [zone](https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_keyval_module.html#keyval_zone). If synchronization of keyval zones in a cluster is enabled, empties the keyval zone only on a target cluster node.
